source: Live validation on M5Stack Tab5, reported 2026-11-06

ble.duplicate_channel: HID report 0xFB (handle 69) carried the same 20-byte frame as FD00 (handle 77); FD00 was used as the canonical event channel

wired_usb.decoder_note: Decrypt all 64 bytes and validate only the first eight-byte event block; later blocks can be non-zero on knob clicks. A 65-byte value with a leading zero is also accepted.

limitations: Only the tested unit and firmware were observed; other revisions may differ.
Wired validation used an ESP32 USB Host HID implementation, not the macOS HIDAPI path.
The D100H firmware version was not recorded.
